mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three months signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise significantly above baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained FEDFUNDS decline, or FEDFUNDS do not decline for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly drop in the unemployment rate below 8.0% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days, reflecting improved labor market conditions and investor optimism.
failure_condition: 5-day returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing the 8.0% threshold, or the rate does not sustain the drop for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (industrial production) signals robust demand-side expansion and supply-side capacity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and RSAFS rise simultaneously in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive when the two proxies move in opposite directions or their combined effect is neutral.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion phase, sustained growth in INDPRO (industrial production) indicates robust supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to rise significantly above baseline during late-cycle expansion, or INDPRO growth does not sustain for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly nonfarm payrolls increase exceeding 200,000 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, signaling strong labor market strength and economic momentum.
failure_condition: 5-day returns remain negative despite the payrolls surge, or the increase does not exceed 200,000 in any month.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in FEDFUNDS and simultaneous drop in UNRATE signals coordinated monetary and labor market easing, amplifying equity valuation gains and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls while UNRATE declines in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive when the two proxies move in opposite directions or their combined effect is neutral.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly growth rate in GDPC1 above 3% for three consecutive months indicates robust demand, compressing interest rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to rise significantly above baseline despite sustained GDPC1 growth, or the growth rate does not exceed 3% for three consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO below its 5-year average triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days, reflecting weakening industrial activity and reduced growth prospects.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite INDPRO dropping below the average, or the decline does not persist for two consecutive months.
